articles.headline: Inside the stunning 72-hour Lakers sale -- and the uncertainty that still looms
articles.description: Three days of secret talks resulted in Mark Walter flipping the Lakers -- and reignited yet another round of bickering among the six Buss siblings.

images.name: Lakers [1296x729]
images.caption: The summer sale of the Lakers sent shockwaves across the sports world, and sent the organization into chaos -- again.
images.credit: AP Photo, Getty Images, Imagn Images

images.name: Shelburne Lakers sale -- photo2 [576x324]
images.caption: When Jeanie Buss sold the Lakers to Walter, she showed Doncic paperwork that assured him that she would still be in charge of his basketball future. Ten months later, that promise is no longer certain.

images.name: Shelburne Lakers sale -- photo3 [576x324]
images.caption: The second sale of the Lakers put the team in significant transition again -- with new owners evaluating everything and squabbling former owners jostling for power and money. Iger and Kushner are Doncic's fifth team owners in the past three years.

articles.headline: Yaxel Lendeborg has 31 points, 12 rebounds as Warriors blow out Nuggets on road
articles.description: In his fourth game, Warriors rookie Yaxel Lendeborg put up 31 points, 12 rebounds and six assists in a blowout road win over the Nuggets on Monday night.

images.name: Yaxel Lendeborg [600x400]
images.caption: "He's as strong as an ox and skilled," Warriors coach Steve Kerr said of Yaxel Lendeborg. "You saw tonight. In all the critical moments of the game, we just put the ball in his hands. For a rookie to be that advanced already, it's extremely rare."

article.title: Detroit plays New York on 3-game win streak
article.linkText: Detroit plays New York on 3-game win streak
article.story: Detroit Pistons (3-0, first in the Eastern Conference) vs. New York Knicks (0-3, 13th in the Eastern Conference) New York; Tuesday, 8 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: Detroit seeks to continue its three-game win streak with a victory against New York. New York went 53-29 overall and 35-17 in Eastern Conference action a season ago. The Knicks gave up 110.1 points per game while committing 20.0 fouls last season. Detroit finished 60-22 overall and 39-13 in Eastern Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Pistons gave up 109.6 points per game while committing 22.0 fouls last season. INJURIES: Knicks: Jose Alvarado: out (ankle). Pistons: Ausar Thompson: out (ankle), Jalen Duren: out (hamstring). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
